title: Push width further: ASPECT_RATIO 80->96 (model_dim 640->768)
description: Changed ASPECT_RATIO from 80 to 96, keeping DEPTH=8 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=128 unchanged, giving model_dim=768 (6 heads) instead of 640; MATRIX_LR=0.06 baseline kept. All 6 agents independently proposed this exact change.
reflection: val_bpb 0.998353 vs baseline 0.999094 -- a real but small ~0.07% relative improvement, a sharp diminishing return compared to the 512->640 jump which gave ~1.3%. Peak VRAM rose to 65.8GB (from 54.1GB at dim=640), still well under the ~79GB ceiling, so VRAM was not the limiter here. The width-scaling curve is clearly flattening: the first doubling-ish step (512->640, +25% dim) bought ~1.3%, this step (640->768, +20% dim) bought ~0.07% -- roughly 18x less bang per similar-sized step. This suggests capacity is close to saturating for this token budget/architecture at model_dim~700-768, and further width pushes (e.g. 96->112) are unlikely to be worth another slot unless someone wants to bracket the exact saturation point. Also notable: model_dim=768 exactly matches the AdamW LR scaling formula's reference point (dmodel_lr_scale=1.0), so this run had zero LR-scaling confound -- a clean read.
